summary: Executed backend API regression suite (17 tests) and frontend Playwright validation for core studio, assembly, quote, branding, camera, pitch mode, desktop/mobile rendering, and mobile drawers.

ui_bugs.issue: Double-click dismiss on rack did not clear rack state; rack quote line remains after repeated direct canvas double-click attempts.

integration_issues.issue: Rack enable updates quote correctly, but double-click rack dismiss does not propagate to rack='none'.

action_items: Fix rack double-click dismissal so onRackDismiss reliably triggers when user double-clicks visible rack geometry.
Re-test rack dismiss on both desktop and mobile and verify quote rack line removal post-dismiss.
critical_code_review_comments: No backend/API critical defects found in tested scope.
Main unresolved user-facing bug is rack dismiss interaction not functioning as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop(1920x800) and mobile(390x844) load checks passed. Merge B01+B02 dimensions, distant merge rejection, assembly metadata inspection, quote toggles/CSV, branding validation/save behavior, camera controls/download, pitch mode enter/escape, and mobile drawer open/close all passed. Rack dismiss via rack double-click remains failing after three targeted attempts.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: enable rack via ceiling tab -> verify quote contains 'ceiling pot rack' -> double-click directly on rack area in canvas -> quote still contains rack line. Likely cause: double-click event on rack mesh not consistently hit or event bubbling/interaction conflict prevents onRackDismiss update from setting config.rack='none'. Mitigation: add explicit UI dismiss control/testid-backed action and/or raycast hit area simplification for rack dismiss.
